# The Research Operating System loop
Semantic pattern: **reinforcing loop with shared state** -> visual type: **loop** * every station **IMPLEMENTED** per the loop note * verified at HEAD `ac770f7`
Task graph + event journal shared record — every pass writes writes writes ResearchProgram scope + hypothesis graph Controller execution lease-fenced dispatch Evidence source outcomes, artifacts SUPPORT / REFUTED evidence ladder (REFUTED terminal) Q-05 — WHY? failure classification + actions Q-04 — WHAT ELSE? failure cone + blast radius Q-02 — WHAT NEXT? ActionEvaluation → eligible ordering Controller dispatch Q-02 order → task graph again tasks evidence rungs falsification fact classification impact view eligible order new/updated tasks Solid ring = the closed feedback loop * dashed spokes = every station writes to the shared record * NO loop driver, NO second scheduler — the controller tick is the only execution engine
